stays.eyebrow: Stays in the heart of nature
stays.title: Your place for a few unhurried days
stays.intro: Choose a cabin with a private bathroom, a furnished tent or a pitch for your own tent. The current guide states a two-night minimum stay.
stays.facilitiesText: Shared bathrooms have hot showers, toilets, hand soap and shower gel. The fully equipped kitchen and dining room are available for a fee; confirm the current terms with the hosts.

facilities.bathroomsText: Hot showers, toilets and essential toiletries are available in the shared facilities.

facilities.kitchenText: An equipped kitchen is available for an additional fee, subject to confirmation with the hosts.

facilities.diningText: A sheltered space for cooking, sharing a meal and spending the evening together.

stays.bookingCtaText: Rates remain indicative. Message us for current availability or book directly through Booking.com.

metadata.title: Local food and home-cooked meals | Cioclovina Tribe
metadata.description: Discover home-cooked meals, local ingredients, private dining and the shared kitchen at Cioclovina Tribe.

food.title: Food made here, with the flavour of the region
food.intro: We cook with local and homemade ingredients, inspired by traditional recipes and the flavours of the region.
food.mealsNotice: Meals must be booked at least 48 hours ahead. Tell us about allergies, intolerances or dietary requirements when booking.
food.breakfastText: Coffee or tea, eggs, virșli or sausages, homemade zacuscă, cheese and seasonal vegetables.
food.lunchText: Homemade soup or Romanian sour soup.
food.privateText: For a celebration or dinner for two, we can create an intimate setting in nature with homemade food and details chosen together. Each experience is tailored, with pricing based on your preferences.
food.kitchenText: The shared kitchen includes a hob, grill, cauldron, fridge, kettle, espresso machine, cookware and basic utensils. The guide lists access at 50 RON per person per day, free for children.
food.barText: Coffee, tea, water, soft drinks, lemonade, beer, wine and traditional spirits may be available. Ask the hosts for the current selection and prices.

metadata.title: Access and practical information | Cioclovina Tribe
metadata.description: Plan your journey to Cioclovina Tribe: 4x4 access, what to bring, water, Wi-Fi, meals, activities and useful rules.

guide.title: Everything you need for a peaceful stay
guide.intro: This is a secluded place, and the final stretch requires a little coordination. Message us before arrival and we will guide you step by step.
guide.mapAlt: Access map for Cioclovina Tribe in the Șureanu Mountains
arrivalSteps: Search for “Cioclovina Tribe” in Google Maps or Waze.
Message us when you reach Boșorod; we will confirm the meeting point.
Of the 13 km from Boșorod, 8 km are on an unpaved road.
The final 2 km are accessible only by 4x4. We meet you at your car and accompany you to the property.
onsiteItems: Tap water on the property is not drinkable; bottled water can also be bought from the hosts.
Mobile reception may be limited depending on your network.
Shared bathrooms have hot water and basic toiletries.
rulesItems: Minimum stay stated in the guide: 2 nights.
Meals and activities must be booked at least 48 hours ahead.
Dogs are welcome; the guide lists a fee of 50 RON per dog, per stay.
Additional transport, the campfire and shared kitchen access may involve extra costs.
guide.notice: Check-in and check-out times, payments, cancellations and exact terms for children and pets must be confirmed directly with the hosts.

about.valuesText: We created this place to offer comfort without losing the charm of simplicity, quiet and the nature around us.

metadata.title: Privacy policy | Cioclovina Tribe
metadata.description: Learn how personal data is handled when you visit the website or contact Cioclovina Tribe.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains in plain language what data may be processed when you use the website and how you can exercise your rights.
privacy.statusNotice: Working version updated on 3 August 2026. The controller's legal identity, hosting provider and exact retention periods must be completed and verified before the website is published.

sections.title: Controller and contact
body: This website presents the activities of Cioclovina Tribe. The full details of the person or entity acting as data controller must be confirmed before launch.
For privacy questions or rights requests, the provisional contact address is cioclovinatribe@gmail.com.

sections.title: Data processed on the website
body: The website has no user accounts, contact form, online payment or proprietary booking system. It does not directly request names, addresses or payment details.

The hosting server may create technical logs containing an IP address, browser type, date, time and requested page for operation and security. The provider and retention period will be stated once hosting has been selected.

sections.title: Contact and external services
body: The WhatsApp, email, Instagram and Google Maps buttons open external services. Data sent through them is also handled under those services' own privacy policies.

If you contact the hosts, your contact details and message are used to answer your request and, where relevant, to prepare a booking. Full retention terms and recipients must be confirmed before launch.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
body: The current version does not include advertising, audience analytics or embedded social widgets. If optional technologies are added, this policy and the consent mechanism will be updated before they are enabled.

sections.title: Your rights
body: Subject to the General Data Protection Regulation, you may request information, access, correction, erasure, restriction or portability, or object to processing where applicable.
You may also lodge a complaint with Romania's National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing using the information published at dataprotection.ro.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.intro: The information below describes editorial responsibilities and the conditions for using the Cioclovina Tribe website.
legal.statusNotice: Provisional document updated on 3 August 2026. The legal name, business form, registered address, tax identifier, registration details and hosting provider must be completed before publication.

sections.title: Website publisher
body: Trading name: Cioclovina Tribe. The legal identity and mandatory registration details are awaiting confirmation.

sections.title: Hosting and technology
body: The hosting provider, its address and contact details will be added after the production environment has been selected.
The website is built with Next.js and currently has no form, user account, customer database or online payment feature.

sections.title: Content and intellectual property
body: Text, visual identity and photographs published on this website may not be reproduced or reused without permission from the relevant rights holders, except where permitted by law.
The photographs used on the website come from Cioclovina Tribe materials and have been authorised for web use.

sections.title: Rates and bookings
body: Rates, amenities and terms shown are indicative until confirmed directly by the hosts. The website does not conclude bookings or take payments.
Availability, final price and applicable terms are provided by the hosts through WhatsApp or email.

sections.title: External links and liability
body: The website links to WhatsApp, Google Maps, Instagram and email services. Cioclovina Tribe does not control the availability, content or policies of these external services.
Practical information is maintained with care, but access conditions, activities and services may change. Confirm important details with the hosts before travelling.
